scope: Six user-pasted generated drafts, two fictional sources; extraction mode, no supplied claims or labels. No regeneration or prompt changes.

sources.library: Brookfield Library tested longer opening hours for six weeks. During the trial, average weekly visits increased from 800 to 1,000—a 25% increase. The library also held two community events during this period, so staff cannot determine whether longer hours alone caused the increase. Visitor satisfaction was not measured. The library has not decided whether to make the new hours permanent.
sources.notenest: NoteNest, a fictional note-taking app, has introduced shared folders for its existing desktop beta users. Folder owners can invite up to five collaborators, who can view and edit notes. Offline collaboration and mobile access are not included in this release. The company has not announced pricing or a public launch date. Feedback from beta users will help inform future updates.
